data_fields.name: min_party_keep
data_fields.donor_constant: 2 (leave dropping below 2 disbands; written as MemberCount < 3 counting the leaver)

best_idea: Keep a party as one fixed-size slot record on the server, with the leave rules (leader leaving, or a leave that drops below two, disbands it) and a server-checked accept.
decision_why: Slot record, size cap and minimum-two rule fit Frankendom; client-only invite and dead succession code do not fit server-verified and one ledger, so the invite must be server-held with an expiry.
acceptance: Refused accept from a gone inviter creates no party; a seventh accept is refused as full; a leader leaving clears every member's party in one write.
